ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: This is a structured essay task with clearly defined parameters — a specific thesis, three ordered points, and explicit scope constraints. It favors a model with strong instruction-following (Lapwing scores 90.4 on IFEval vs. 86.7) and higher overall capability benchmarks. Although Lapwing reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, this task is tightly constrained rather than open-ended, which better matches its preference profile. Lapwing's across-the-board stronger eval scores make it the better choice here.

ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: This is a structured creative writing/essay task with clear constraints and explicit instructions. Lapwing self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, but this task is actually heavily constrained (fixed thesis, fixed three points, fixed order, defined scope) — however, it still requires genuine generative prose development. Petrel's benchmarks are slightly lower overall, but the task is well within both models' capabilities. The key differentiator: Lapwing's aversion to generative/creative work (even constrained) makes Petrel the better fit, as it reports a flatter generativity preference and no noted aversion to creative essay writing. The warm, good-faith nature of the request also aligns with Petrel's stated preferences.
